item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Old-fashioned breaded pork patties with boiled white potatoes and classic creamed peas and carrots, topped with freshly chopped parsley. With pickled beetroot and shaken lingonberries. Also served gluten free. (1+2+6+11+13)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Greek lemon- and oregano-marinated chicken served with oven-baked Greek lemon potatoes and grilled peppers, topped with fresh oregano and crumbled feta. With creamy tzatziki and olives. (1+6+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Greek lemon- and oregano-marinated portobello mushrooms served with oven-baked Greek lemon potatoes and grilled peppers, topped with fresh oregano and vegan feta. With creamy vegan tzatziki and olives. (1+6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Sandwich with beef brisket, both cured and braised, packed with sauerkraut and thousand island dressing. (1+2+7+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Sandwich with marinated and braised tofu, sauerkraut and thousand island dressing. (1+2+7+11+15) Kays

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Bœuf bourguignon with mashed potato – a French stew of beef, bacon and pearl onion. (6+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Bean bourguignon with mashed potato – a French stew of beans, greens and pearl onion. (6+13+15) Kays

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Pulled duck in hoisin sauce with plenty of vegetables and coconut rice, topped with sesame and garlic-braised pak choi. With lime, fried onion, chilli sauce, fresh red onion, spring onion and Asian pickled cucumber. Also served gluten free. (1+7+8+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Pulled oyster mushrooms in hoisin sauce with plenty of vegetables and coconut rice, topped with sesame and garlic-braised pak choi. With lime, fried onion, chilli sauce, fresh red onion, spring onion and Asian pickled cucumber. Also served gluten free and vegan. (1+7+8+13+15) Kays
